articles.title: GHSA: GitPython: Unguarded git option forwarding in Repo.init enables arbitrary command execution via --template clone hooks
articles.summary:
## Summary
`Repo.init()` forwards `**kwargs` verbatim to `git init` with no unsafe-option guard and no `allow_unsafe_options` parameter. `git init --template=<dir>` copies `<dir>/hooks/*` into the new repo's `.git/hooks`, so an attacker-controlled `template` kwarg plants a hook that executes on the next git operation → arbitrary code execution. `--template` is already recognized as unsafe for clon

articles.title: GHSA: GitPython: Unguarded git read-tree option forwarding in IndexFile.from_tree/reset/merge_tree enables arbitrary file overwrite
articles.summary:

articles.title: CVE-2026-15152 — CVSS 5.3
articles.summary: The WP Hotel Booking WordPress plugin before 2.3.2 does not verify that a payment notification corresponds to a payment made to the site's own merchant account, nor that the paid amount matches the booking total, allowing unauthenticated users to have their bookings marked as fully paid without any payment reaching the site owner.

articles.title: CVE-2026-15149 — CVSS 5.3
articles.summary: The WP Hotel Booking WordPress plugin before 2.3.3 does not ensure that room quantities and the resulting order total are non-negative when placing a booking, and relies on client-controlled cart data, allowing unauthenticated users to create confirmed reservations for free or at an arbitrarily reduced price.
